creator: Alexander Terp
description: Close.by is a pane id from the closing machine, and the other machine's daemon cannot resolve it to that machine's participant (name@lap), so the stall watch's 'closed by its sender' suppression never applies across machines. Found in review of the Close.by change on 2026-11-13. Fixing it means carrying the closer's messaging identity across the link.
title: A pane closed from another machine by the agent waiting on it is still reported as a stall
